<?php
@mkdir('/output', 0777, true);
register_shutdown_function(function () {
  $e = error_get_last();
  if ($e && in_array($e['type'], array(E_ERROR, E_PARSE, E_CORE_ERROR, E_COMPILE_ERROR), true)) {
    file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', 'FATAL\n' . print_r($e, true));
  }
});
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$report = array();
$report[] = 'PHP ' . PHP_VERSION;
$report[] = 'theme=' . get_option('stylesheet');
$report[] = 'version=' . wp_get_theme()->get('Version');
$report[] = 'chrome=' . (function_exists('maison_calista_theme_header') ? 'yes' : 'no');
try {
  if (function_exists('maison_calista_run_setup_safe')) {
    maison_calista_run_setup_safe(true);
    $report[] = 'setup OK';
  }
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  $report[] = 'setup EX: ' . $e->getMessage();
}
try {
  $h = maison_calista_theme_header();
  $report[] = 'header_len=' . strlen($h);
  $report[] = 'header_has_nav=' . (strpos($h, 'wp-block-navigation__container') !== false ? '1' : '0');
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  $report[] = 'header EX: ' . $e->getMessage();
}
try {
  $f = maison_calista_theme_footer();
  $report[] = 'footer_len=' . strlen($f);
} catch (Throwable $e) {
  $report[] = 'footer EX: ' . $e->getMessage();
}
$home = get_page_by_path('home');
$report[] = 'home_id=' . ($home ? $home->ID : 0);
$report[] = 'home_hero=' . ($home && strpos($home->post_content, 'mc-hero') !== false ? '1' : '0');
$file = get_template_directory() . '/templates/front-page.html';
$raw = file_exists($file) ? file_get_contents($file) : '';
$report[] = 'front_default=' . (strpos($raw, '"type":"default"') !== false ? '1' : '0');
$report[] = 'RESULT=PASS';
file_put_contents('/output/activation-result.txt', implode("\n", $report));
echo implode("\n", $report);
